lines.trans: You see, we are an ideal and harmonious couple.
We love animals very much and take care of them.
In our good apartment it is always warm and peaceful.
Hector will be able to walk in the beautiful park every day.
And sleep on the soft couch by the bed.
The owner is very glad about our kind words.
She sees how much we suit each other.
Careful, Max, this is just our clever game.
The main thing is that the dog finally found its home.
I am sincerely happy to take this good dog.
Let's go quickly, Hector is waiting for us by the door.
Now our life will become much better together.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.
I'm listening right by my ear.
The car is parked near the house.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

гулять.gloss: to walk, to go for a walk

meanings.en: to walk, to stroll, to be outside

examples.trans: A girl walks a little dog there.
Let's go for a walk in the park.
The door is behind the wardrobe.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
He is sitting on the sofa.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.trans: There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: Наш коллектив маленький, но очень дружный.
examples.trans: Our collective is small, but very friendly.

заботиться.gloss: to care for; to look after

забрать.gloss: to take back, to take away

meanings.en: to take away, to pick up

meanings.note: забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

подходить.gloss: to approach, to come up; to suit

meanings.note: очередь подходит = one's turn is coming up
это мне подходит = that suits me

examples.trans: Let's go, our turn in the queue is coming up.

To give boots to vicious dogs.

meanings.note: short form only: рад, рада, радо, рады; no long-form cases

examples.trans: I'm very glad to see you.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to

examples.trans: We came as soon as we could.
